about: Milestone NI of ADR 0012, the integration slice of N1b, N2 and N3: the catalogue cases of CF-21 to CF-28 and FX-24/d and /e, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which NI wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite, with control-flow/waits, N2's waits and retries inside containers. Each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a milestone and a reason; the reference's revision SC4 made the new cases CF-21/b to CF-21/e and CF-22/b to CF-22/e from these fixtures' recordings, and their runs cite them, while CF-22/f and CF-22/g are recorded by milestone N5's fixture flows/control-flow/subflow-retry, outside this batch, and CF-21/f and CF-22/h are requested from batch E3f. CF-23/a and /b put a failure module beside a container, which windmill-lite runs since milestone N3c. The CE image completed six squashed loops with the results of their unsquashed forms and none with the OSS stub's error, which the catalogue records as CF-25/d (whether it reuses one runtime across iterations is Q-CF-19, still open); CF-25/a describes a build without the private feature, outside the reference configuration, and is deferred. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: source-derived, added in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29) by its validation round 1, and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a container's throwing timeout and parallelism). A container's timeout is evaluated with the flow input of the container step's own flow, so it sees an iter that input has: CF-21/e's collapsed flow run with the input {"iter": {"index": 3}} gets the timeout 13 and succeeds with [1], and an inner loop in an outer loop's child flow reads the outer iteration's iter, its timeout 10, and succeeds with [2]. windmill-lite evaluates a container's timeout with its flow's input (internal/engine, childTimeout), as the case reads, but no run checks it yet

oracle-observed in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), from a fixture outside this batch: milestone N5's flows/control-flow/subflow-retry run while_retry (oracle run 40915682847) records it; no run of this batch records it. A retried while loop whose body collapses lists x's failed script job, with step_id w, and the retry's iteration runs with the same arguments. N5's gate runs that fixture on windmill-lite (cmd/wltest TestSubflowRetryFixturesFreshAndWarm)

oracle-observed in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), from a fixture outside this batch: milestone N5's flows/control-flow/subflow-retry run branchone_retry (oracle run 40915682847) records it; no run of this batch records it. A retried branchone lists the branch's failed child flow (kind flowpreview, args {}) and runs the branch again. N5's gate runs that fixture on windmill-lite (cmd/wltest TestSubflowRetryFixturesFreshAndWarm)

source-derived in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a retried parallel container). A retried parallel loop (deployed, run by path, with skip_failures: false and parallelism: 1) re-enters from the last child to complete, here iteration 1's, which succeeded, so both re-run iterations see its iter as iter_parent and l lists no failed attempt. windmill-lite differs today: its engine starts from the last child to fail (internal/engine, a reading taken where the reference was silent), which gives {"index": 0, "value": 10}; a follow-up of NI implements it
the catalogue gives it as CF-V3/a, a child flow failing at its pickup, which N3c's row covers with the CF-V cases

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). Route 3 inside a branchone: the branch job stores the InternalError, while its parent gets the branch's last carried value, 1, as the flow's failed result and as c's previous_result. windmill-lite implements it since NI's follow-up FU8: a child flow that aborts at a later transition hands its parent its last carried value, which a branchone or a flow step carries on, while lookups read the stored InternalError (internal/engine, flowEnd.delivered; TestBranchOneAbortedBranch, TestSubflowAborted)

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). The parent's failure module gets the branch's carried value 1 as previous_result, and an error derived from it by JE-17's rule 3 (UnknownError). windmill-lite implements it since NI's follow-up FU8 (internal/engine, flowEnd.delivered; TestBranchOneAbortedFailureModule)

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a branchone aborted at a later transition). retry_if sees the carried value 1 as result and previous_result, with the derived error, so b is retried once. windmill-lite implements it since NI's follow-up FU8 (internal/engine, flowEnd.delivered; TestBranchOneAbortedRetryIf, with the false-predicate control)
a raw flow payload: windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6); the harness runs deployed flows by path only

outside the reference configuration: the catalogue gives the case for a build without the private feature (features=oss), not the published CE image, and says it is not recorded; the run later, which cited it, records the CE image instead, as CF-25/d: the flow succeeds with its unsquashed result. windmill-lite accepts squash and ignores it, running the loop unsquashed (internal/engine, TestContainerSquash), which gives the six results CF-25/d records; whether the CE image reuses one runtime across iterations is Q-CF-19, still open
the Enterprise Edition's squash (EE): the reference establishes no expectation (Q-CF-11), and the oracle is the Community Edition

source-derived in the reference's revision SC3 (2026-10-29): CE ignores squash on a loop module with a sleep and on a parallel loop, which start no runners, so both of the case's flows give [1, 2]; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (squash and ai parallelism on the CE image). No run of this batch records the case as written: the run control-flow/cf-25/parallel records a squashed parallel loop after a first step, which gives [1, 2] (it records CF-25/d). windmill-lite accepts squash and ignores it, running the loop unsquashed (internal/engine, TestContainerSquash), which gives the case's result
a raw submission, which does not collapse (CF-V5): windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6)
